content: Firaun mi'ini
La'pa lardoini anni wor lia (ler maka Yusup nwet nana Firaun hopopanni rora mi'ini) noma Firauna nmi'a, de e ntutrier lia gerlawna Nila aratni.
Namkek la gerlawna Nila ralamni de hayori wo'itu mak kapetna me klita-kwora. Noka rlergot la gerlawna ralamni pa ra'an wewan no'a gerlawan de aratni.

Nhor nioka namkek nan owa'ana hayori dom pali, liawanni wo'itu rlergot la gerlawna Nila de ralamni. Hayori ri rpo'ora-rpaiti me inonni re yotyata. Noka rla rtutrier lia hayori mandiditu mak kala' ulu re onni, la'a gerlawan de aratni.
Hayori maka kpo'ora-kpaiti me inonni yotyata re ra'ana hayori mandidit muaka kapetna me mak inonni klita-kwora re. Dewade Firaun namat wa.
Nhor nioka nanin owa'ana noka nmi' owa'an re'eni wornu, namkek de metma harni wo'itu rhargot la onni ida de na'unu-nayeha.
Mere nhor nioka namkek nan owa'ana metma harni wo'itu dom to'a, maka anin tipru rhi'a pa rapliau.
Harni mak kilta re rtelan nan hare mandiditnu mak ka'unu-kayeha re. Dewade Firaun namat wa. Mere hadi e nmi' to'a.
La'pa yawyawar ma'ta de ralamni edon namtemna, noka nhopan pa rpolg awoka mak katga khi' ukru-rehera Mesir re honona. Firaun nwahaur nohora mi'ini rla mere riy id mana edon nala nnia'eratni la.
Noka mak khi' o'ta la mak katiaka yemyemun de nakot la Firaun: “Ler di de na'nama aghoratnana a do'u-ha'lu mak ululu.
Ler maka matro'mu nawenan la am die, noma rho'la agora mutwua'lu la mak katiaka ray romni ralamni,
de, la mela ida amro'a mi'a, mere rima-rima nor mi'ini me nnia'eratni.
La hande de, tuwgari Ibrani id nor rewre'w ami, mak katiaka ray romni hopopanni de, ampahaur nohora ami' mamni la, noka nwahaur nohora rima-rima mi'ini na'itra nnia'eratni memna.
Ne emolmolla maka ha nakota mai ami, emkadella pa la nlola de a'uwali owa'an la a mtatange'nu ne a mutwua'lu mana rla rwairi wenna.”
Nwahauru pa nhorwua noka, Firaun nhopan pa rpolga Yusup. Pleta-plet pa ralgota la nhio'la geni ralamni, ni'ir doini nurnu wullu, me nhernu naniayarni noka nla'awa Firaun gaini.
Rla' noka Firaun nakot la Yusup: “A'g e mi'a, ne riy id mana ta'en niana nwet nana nnia'eratni, mere a'utlin nan olek o'owa, riwra hornama mutlin nan to'a mi'a, dewade omukota nnia'eratni.”
Yusup nwahla Firaun: “Matroma, edonan toto'a mai a'u, mere Uplerlawna ed maka hota kade'et nohora lira wniahla kalwied la matro'mu Firaun.”
Noka Firaun nakot la Yusup: “La mi'u di ralamni de a'g e tiutrier lia gerlawna Nila aratni,
Noka umkek de la'a gerlawna Nila ralamni de hayori wo'itu rhargot de rapetna me inonni rlita-rwora, ne ra'an wewan no'a gerlawan de aratni.
Mere nhi'noka umkek nan owa'ana hayori wo'itu rhargot de ulatni rwow rer tio'a rurni, ne rpo'ora-rpaiti, a'g edon umkek ma'ta maka yatni emkarella la'a noh Mesir di wawannu.
Hayori maka yata me kpo'ora re ra'ana hayori mandiditnu mak kapetna me mak klita-kwora re.
Mere apannu edonna rmarna, me ndella genni. Noka a'umat wa.
Amui' wali de metma harni wo'itu mak klipa-ka'ma rlergot la onni ida.
Mere nhi'noka umkek nan metma harni mak kerna me mak anin tipru nhi' apliaga de wo'itu, rhargota.
Harni mak kahgali me kilta re rlumu hare mandiditnu mak ka'unu-kayeha re. Ukot olek hadella mak katu re honona, mere id mana ta'eni nwet nana nnia'eratni mai a'u.”
Noka Yusup nakot la Firaun: “Matro'mu Firaun mi'ini rora re ramneneha. Uplerlawna Nakot oleka la matro'mu Firaun hya' maka Uplerlawna Niwra Nhi'a-nyapia.
Hayori mandiditnu mak klita-kwora rde anni wo'itu, ne metma har mandiditnu re mana anni wo'it wuali, mi'a rora, ramneneha.

Hayori mandiditu mak kpo'ora me yata maka khargot la li'iru rde, de nnia'eratni de anni wo'itu, emekwali metma har mandiditnu mak kapliau me kahgali onnila anin tipru rde, nnia'eratni de hota anni wo'it die rehka-lara.
Emekto'a a'ukot olek la matro'mu Firauna, Uplerlawna Ntutga la matro'mu Firaun hya' mak pena Nhi'a.
Hota la'a anni wo'it ralamni de pripanni-fa'anni la noh Mesir di wawannu tetema.
Nhor diemade hota anni wo'it die rehka-lara, nreiniande hota rhorat doini anin mandiditu muaka kodi pripanni-fa'anni re, yoma lar de nhi'a noh di pa nkerna-nhau.
Hota edon ramkek nan etia pripanni-fa'anni korni-tre'eni onnila lar de, yoma lar matmiat miemna di.
La'pa Ntut lia mi' de re'eni wor lia matro'mu de nnia'eratni de, hade de Uplerlawna Net tiarg oleka, de edon nalo'ona ne Uplerlawna Nhi'a.
Hade pede samounu de matro'mu Firaun nwahak nana riy mak katu me maka wniarora plalahwani ida, pa mriana pa nhi'a mak kodi plolli la noh Mesir di wawannu.
Samounu wal die Matro'mu Firaun nhi' emkadi, de de mpuagamtatna mak katu klina-kmat la noh di, ne la'a anni mandidit muaka pripanni-fa'anni de rawoka id la nhiakra wolim la'a Mesir di wullu-we'elli.

Rawok memna yamanna hya'a-hya' to'a la'a anni-anni pripanni-fa'anni mak hota nala' ulu ri, ne la'a matro'mu Firaun plolli-mneheni de raniutnia metma wo'oni la leta-let lawna re emeka ha yaya'ana pa rwatierun targa.
Emkadella yaman ara re rla'a yamanna wniaho'a-wniatiernu totpa hota ra'ana la noh di la'a anin mandidit muaka lara ha nwewar nan la Mesir di tetema, totpa noh di yana npohra-niata onnila la lara.”
Yusup nhi' mak kodi plolli-ktaryatnu la'a Mesir
Firaun nora tniutnu-nhianni-nhielli-liarni honona re rwayow nohora wakwak de yoma rlina-rmata de samoga.
Noka Firaun nakot la tniutnu-nhianni-nhielli-liarni re: “Ama-hyal miy re, hota it edon tlernana riy dom mak emekto'a Yusup di, de riy maka Uplerlawna Nhiwni Npenpuenu-nanahala ralamni.”
Firaun nakot la Yusup: “Ama, onnila Uplerlawna Nakot momuou oleka hari tiy o'a, mak katu me mak ktarga wniarora-wnialai samomuou id mana ematia' o'a.
O' ed mak kla'a mak kodi plola-ktaryat lia ro'mu nayanni, ne lima-rora honona re ratlina-ratailla hopopna-lili'irmu, mere enekneka a' tio' pa a'g edon utlin la tiy o'a.
La hadi wawannu pede, atiutmuata-kiewra'u pa mlia'a mak kodi plola-ktaryat lia noha Mesir wawannu.”

Nhor nioka Firaun nur dioinia kdieli maka nhi'inde ndidnia pa nodi plolli la kniarni wawannu, na'nama nohoga la Yusup okarni. Nhor nioka nala koka mnurnuhru la Yusup nnairia, ne nwairia wui miaha la tiernu.

Noka Firaun nhopan Yusup pa la nha'ata kereta, ne riy riarin nohor la Yusup de rhaun pa niwra: “Kalwiedoo!” Emkadella la'a Firauna nrana me ntutmuata-nkewra'a Yusup pa ndella Firaun walli malganna pa nodi plolli la Mesir wawannu.
Firaun nakot la Yusup: “Ama, omuatg olekaw de, a' di de ray Mesir, mere la'pa o' edon mpuayow nan riy, de riy id mana ta'en niana nwo'la-nlekur la Mesir di ralamni.”

Noka Firaun nala Yusup pa nwawa Safnat-Pa'aneah, ne na'ala Potifera a'nani Asnat pa Yusup nhi'a la hawni. Potifer di, de makpolwunu-kwaklera no'a leta Ona. Emkade pa Yusup de emeka mak kodi plola-ktaryat lia noha Mesir.
Yusup aninni terampwotelu la'a ler maka Firaun nhi'a la hopopanni, noka Yusup naltaru Firaun pa la nwakdior momuou Mesir uhunu-ewatni-ewatni-lahwani.
Lowan de, nala wullu-we'elli nniutni-nniutni la'a anin mandidit muaka kodi pripanni-fa'anni de.

Noka Yusup nawoka yamanna hya'-hya' to'a maka ha rara'ana la Mesir wawannu la'a anin mandiditu re, na'nama rwaho'a-rwatiernia la leta-letlawna re. Lowan mak kdella letlawna re onni de wullu-we'elli rawoka la leta-leta re ralamni.
Emkade pa Yusup naniutnia metma rde harahu rehia pa emeka en liu'wu-tan miakum no' eni wawannu, nreiniande edon nrekn owa'ana, onnila harahu rehi pa ta'eni rrekan nana.
La'pa anni mandidit muaka kodi rehka-lara edonna nmai mia'ta de, Yusup hawni Asnata na'ana nana muanke'a wor lia Yusupa.
Yusup nweta a'nani yanul die Menasye, (nnia'eratni de, nhoratdoini), yoma niwra: “Uplerlawna Nhi' a' pua ghoratdoin memna a ralam meh'ru la a a'mu romni.”
Ne a'nani gari de nweta la Efraima (nnia'eratni de, pripanni-fa'anni liawanni) yoma niwra: “Uplerlawna Nhi' a' pua liernan pripanni-fa'anni la gen miaka aghoptutu-ghopler la.”
La'pa anni mandidit muaka kodi pripanni-fa'anni la' Mesir de nlardoinla,
dewade anni mandidit muaka kodi rehka-lara nmai wia, la' noha-rai korni re lara nwewar nana, mere la' Mesir de yamanna erla emeka hya' maka Yusup nakot oleka la.
La'pa Mesir noh tetema nler la lara ne lima-rora rwak meman la Firaun pa nala yamanna, dewade Firaun nakot la makden Mesir re: “Mlia'awa Yusup de pa mhi'a hya' maka ha nakota tiy miy.”
Lar de na'ititar lol to'owa pa nwewar nan noh Mesir tetema, pede Yusupa nhari dudanni (gudang) re honona pa na'olu metam la makden Mesir.
Ne la'a riy mak kdella noheri-woru lyanti nayanni mana rmai Mesir pa rawelia metam la Yusup, yoma lar de lawan rehi la nohkerna-rai miaran tetema.
